title: The Bangladeshi garment industry wage board agrees to increase minimum wages following five days of worker protests and clashes with police. Workers demand ৳30,000 (US$240) monthly, up from ৳12,500 (US$100), while the board has not specified the increase.
summary: The Bangladeshi garment industry wage board agrees to increase minimum wages following five days of worker protests and clashes with police.
